title: The Mislabelled Boxes
summary: Start with the box whose label gives you the most certainty.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Three boxes are labelled Apples, Oranges and Mixed.
You may take out one fruit from one box without looking inside. Which box do you pick to fix all the labels?
points: Three boxes are labelled Apples, Oranges and Mixed.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Because all labels are wrong, the box labelled Mixed cannot really be mixed.
That is a strong clue. Start where the most is known.
points: Because all labels are wrong, the box labelled Mixed cannot really be mixed.

steps.title: The method: Use the certain one
sentences: Pick from the box labelled Mixed.
Suppose you pull out an apple.
Then that box holds only apples, because it cannot be mixed.
points: Pick from the box labelled Mixed.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Then the box labelled Oranges cannot hold oranges, and it cannot be apples either, so it is Mixed.
The box labelled Apples must be Oranges.
points: Then the box labelled Oranges cannot hold oranges, and it cannot be apples either, so it is Mixed.

quiz.q: Why do we pick from the box labelled Mixed?
options: Its label is wrong, so it holds only one fruit
quiz.why: A wrong Mixed label means it is a pure box.
